title: Dataq Quanta — Overview
meta_description: Emerging compute with investor discipline — baselines, benchmarks, verdicts.

blocks.x: Emerging compute with investor discipline — baselines, benchmarks, verdicts. Dataq Quanta is the platform layer behind it — deployed under NDA, documented for the audit.

Dataq Quanta runs our quantum and advanced-compute programs: readiness assessments with HNDL risk clocks, solver tournaments (classical vs. quantum-inspired vs. hybrid) on your actual formulations, PQC migration with CBOM-grade discovery, HPC engineering, and the emerging-silicon watchlist. Quanta's discipline is economic: every initiative carries a classical baseline it must beat on identical benchmarks; negative results are documented deliverables. Where solvers win, we industrialize them as services with re-solve SLAs; where they don't, you keep an improved baseline and a revisit trigger.

blocks.x: Quanta's PQC work aligns to NIST FIPS 203/204/205 with crypto-agility architectures that make future transitions configuration events. All benchmarks publish methodology and baselines — your quantum narrative survives diligence because it is true.

Dataq Quanta runs under NDA in Banking & Financial Services, Energy & Utilities, Logistics & Supply Chain, Manufacturing & Industrial, Healthcare & Life Sciences. Deployments stay private; the architecture and control packs are the part we can show.
Connects to: Qiskit, PennyLane, Gurobi/CP-SAT, Slurm, CUDA, CBOM tooling. Adapters are versioned and contract-tested, so upgrades stop being incidents.
If Dataq Quanta is on your agenda this year, a briefing will tell you in 45 minutes whether this pattern fits your estate.
